detail: cli-a-04.test.ts: `werk add retry --parent checkout` printed 'retry: proposed' (no 'added'); the log grew by one node.proposed with parent 'checkout'; `werk show retry` header had 'proposed' and 'parent: checkout  Checkout flow'. After `werk accept retry --actor you` the log grew by one change.accepted, show had no 'proposed' and the same parent, and a second ghost 'other' still showed 'proposed'.

Proposed refunds under payments, partial under refunds, a depends_on link partial->fraud with --why, an option (alternative_to) and a source (supported_by). Before the accept the '-> depends_on fraud' line in `werk show partial` said 'held'. `werk accept partial --actor you` wrote only change.accepted events (no edge event); refunds, partial, the option and the source all showed without 'proposed', and the depends_on line showed without 'held'.

After `werk discard email-verification`, `werk show` of email-verification and resend-email both exited 1 with 'no node #... in the map'; `werk show onboarding` held no 'ghost' text and no '<- refines' child line.

A second `werk add search-index` with other title/why exited 1 with 'refused: a ghost's words are frozen: #search-index is proposed; discard it and propose it again'; the log lines were unchanged; `werk show search-index` printed the first title and 'why: One index is simple'.

`werk accept audit-log` (no --actor) exited 1, the log was unchanged and show still had 'proposed'; `werk accept audit-log --actor you` exited 0 and show printed 'card audit-log  [open]' without 'proposed'.

Seeded decided auth with children login/session and login depends_on audit. `werk remove auth --actor you` wrote one node.removed event; show of auth/login/session exited 1 and none appeared in `werk find`, `werk search`, `werk search <term>` or `werk show root`; `werk removed` named auth, login, session; `werk show audit` lost the depends_on login line. After `werk restore auth --actor you` auth showed '<- refines login/session', audit showed '<- depends_on login' again, and `werk removed` printed 'no card is removed'.

`werk remove auth --actor you --reparent`: show auth exited 1, login and session showed 'parent: platform'. After `werk restore auth --actor you` auth showed 'parent: platform', login/session showed 'parent: auth', and `werk show platform` had no refines line to login or session.

login (under access) depends_on session (under state). After remove login, remove session, restore login (all --actor you), `werk show login` exited 0 and had no 'session' text; after `werk restore session --actor you` login showed '-> depends_on session' and session showed '<- depends_on login'.

After `werk remove login --actor you`, `werk show rfc-6749` still showed '<- supported_by billing'. `werk add login ...` exited 1 with an error naming the restore of #login ('...id stays taken; restore #login...'), the log was unchanged, no node.proposed event exists and show login printed no ghost.
`werk remove login` without --actor exited non-zero; `werk show login` still exited 0 and the log lines were unchanged.
After `werk remove login --actor you`, `werk restore login` without --actor exited non-zero; `werk show login` still exited 1, `werk find` did not list login, and the log lines were unchanged.

On a seeded log, `werk add use-log --title/--body/--why --parent storage` printed 'proposed' and appended exactly one line with all earlier lines byte-equal; show printed title, body and why with 'proposed' in the header. `werk accept use-log --actor you` exited 0, appended exactly one line, and show printed the same words without 'proposed' or 'ghost'.
`werk accept use-log` without --actor exited 1, the log was unchanged and show still had 'proposed'; with --actor you show had no 'proposed'.

On ghost 'Use a log': `werk edit --body`, `werk retitle ... 'Use an append-only log'` and a second `werk add` with the same id each exited non-zero and left the log unchanged; show printed title line 'Use a log' with 'proposed' in the header.

After accept with --actor you, `werk retitle use-log 'Use an append-only log'` exited 0 and appended exactly one line; show printed the new title and not 'Use a log'; the earlier node.proposed line with title 'Use a log' was still in the log. `werk edit use-log --body ...` then showed the new body and the new title.

A plain `werk add --kind excerpt` is refused ('An excerpt comes only from a quote'), so the excerpt was added with `werk quote use-log storage-talk '<words>'` from a seeded .werk/chats/storage-talk.jsonl. The option add, the source add and the quote each printed 'proposed' and appended exactly one line; show of each printed its fields (why not; url/finding; words/speaker/conversation) with 'proposed'. After `werk accept use-log:opt0 --actor you` the option showed real with the same why-not, and the source and excerpt still showed 'proposed'. (The option was also linked alternative_to the card, one extra link event outside the add.)

Read 'as its basis' as a depends_on link. `werk link use-sqlite storage --type depends_on --why ...` exited 1: 'refused: a depends_on link cannot point to an ancestor: #storage is above #use-sqlite', because the step puts Use SQLite under Storage. No held edge exists, so the rest cannot run. Variant for information: with Use SQLite under root instead, the link shows held, goes live on accept, and the log has one edge.added; so the conflict is between the step's setup and the product's no-depends_on-to-ancestor rule.

Ghosts auth (under platform), magic-links (under auth), email-service (under platform), magic-links depends_on email-service. After `werk accept magic-links --actor you`, magic-links and auth showed without 'proposed' (auth with 'parent: platform'), email-service still showed 'proposed', and magic-links' depends_on email-service line still said 'held'.

Storage seeded as decided (as the basis). On ghost use-sqlite the agent added option use-sqlite:opt0 (alternative_to), source benchmark (supported_by), `werk kill --revisit` (needed by the contract), `werk edit --who me` and `werk status use-sqlite decided`: none refused. After `werk accept use-sqlite --actor you` show printed '[decided]', 'who: me' and no 'proposed'; the option was real with its why-not; benchmark was real with a live '<- supported_by use-sqlite' line (no 'held').

After `werk discard auth` (with ghost magic-links under it and ghost option magic-links:opt0), show of all three exited 1 and `werk find` listed none of them; `werk show platform` had no 'proposed', no 'ghost' and no '<- refines' line.

Storage (decided) with one decided child who=you and an unchallenged waiver showed 'subtree: 2 cards, 2 decided, 1 unchallenged' and no stale mark (also absent from `werk stale`). A ghost use-sqlite set decided with a ghost option left that line and the no-stale state unchanged; after `werk accept use-sqlite --actor you` it read 'subtree: 3 cards, 3 decided, 1 unchallenged'. Storage was seeded decided so the ghost's decide passed the basis check.
